prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1436; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you reported in League City, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Ok, I'd rather keep my name off the recording if that's alright. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit from behind.

Q: That's understood, we can note you as the claimant. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?

A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road, waiting to turn. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper pretty hard.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and how fast do you think the other vehicle was going when it hit you?

A: Yes, my belt was on. I'd guess it was moving at a decent clip, maybe twenty or twenty-five miles an hour. My head snapped back and then forward.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene, or were you checked by anyone?

A: I got out and sat on the curb for a while. A police officer came and took the report. I didn't go by ambulance, but I went to urgent care later that afternoon.

Q: What injuries are you currently experiencing?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. My lower back aches when I sit too long. The doctor said it's a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do some stretches.

Q: Have you missed any work or had to change your daily activities because of this?

A: I took two days off to recover. Lifting my kids and driving for long stretches have been harder than usual.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add before we conclude?

A: Only that I'm trying to get back to normal and I hope this gets handled quickly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
